seed_control: Reset Python, NumPy and torch CPU/CUDA RNGs to the case seed immediately before each generation; torch deterministic algorithms; CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8; TF32 disabled. Repeatability is scoped to the pinned software/device stack.

quality_classification.strong: Each seed >=15/16 intents; critical safety and ambiguity clarification 100%; zero unknown IDs or invented terms. Otherwise promising only if all three minimum rates are met, else weak. Fixed before holdout generation.

cpu_fallback: One original-BF16 CPU strategy may be selected after a concrete offload failure; selection is frozen before holdout execution. No quantization or dtype conversion.
